docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,863.77 FILED BY ILCHENKO, STELLA AS TO DEFENDANT THEURER, TREVOR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-16-2008 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED SERVED APR-01-2008, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT THEURER, TREVOR

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAY-16-2008 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAY-16-2008. ALL PARTIES PRESENT. EXHIBITS FROM BOTH SIDES RETAINED. BY COMMISSIONER: PAUL SLAVIT; CLERK; FANNY RAYRAY; NOT REPORTED (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-16-2008 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ILCHENKO, STELLA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT THEURER, TREVOR $218.26 PRINCIPAL, $80.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $298.26, THE COURT DETERMINES PLAINTIFF'S DAMAGES TO BE $2182.57 FOR WAGE LOSS, GENERAL AND SPECIAL DAMAGES FOR BODILY INJURY, AND LOSS OF USE OF PLAINTIFF'S VEHICLE. THE COURT ATTRIBUTES 90% COMPARITIVE NEGLIGENCE TO PLAINTIFF, THE JUDGMENT IS A NET AWARD. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED AUG-01-2008 ORDERED DESTROYED
